name: nopCommerce 500 Natural-Language User Question Dataset
scope: Natural e-commerce analytics questions for the nopCommerce AEGIS semantic-layer implementation.
notes: Supported questions are intended to be answerable by the current nopCommerce semantic layer.
Boundary questions are realistic e-commerce questions a non-technical store owner might ask, but they require concepts or templates not currently implemented.
The dataset evaluates semantic-layer coverage, not infinite text-to-SQL coverage.
